rationale: I start with what could go wrong, and here the first problem is the data itself. A quant output showing a 77% margin of safety, built on a five-year average FCF equal to more than a quarter of the market cap, makes me suspicious rather than excited. The debt-to-equity figure of 0.0 may be right, but I cannot rule out that debt is simply untagged, and I do not assume it away. The snapshot has no business description, no year-by-year cash flow, no balance sheet detail and no catalyst, so several of my required checks cannot be performed and have not been met. Cash is a position. I will do the primary-document work and not pay for a number I cannot verify.
